title: Fish Shopping
shortDescription: Catch, cut, and sell fish in a cozy 3D harbor market.
fullDescription:
Run your own waterfront fish market. Cast from the pier, process catches on the cutter, stock the counter, and serve a growing crowd. Hire staff, unlock upgrades, take delivery contracts, and expand to new harbors — all with a fixed 20 Hz simulation shared by Android and web.

First session loop: fish → cut → stock → sell.

Optional cloud sync and privacy-safe analytics are off until you opt in. One-time harbor unlock and power-neutral cosmetics are available via in-app purchase; Restore purchases recovers entitlements on a new device.
whatsNew: 1.0.1 balance pass — cheaper early bag upgrade and first hires, slightly better portion prices, faster staff XP. Schema unchanged; 1.0.0 saves still load.
